maul_url.description: MAUL API base URL. v1 requests use legacy paths; v2 requests append /v2 paths.

maul_key.description: MAUL API key. Empty disables authentication.

api_version.description: MAUL API version: v1 or v2. Changing this requires plugin reload.

division_id.description: v2 only: division id recorded on penalties.

console_admin_user_id.description: v2 only: MAUL user id for console/rcon bans.

game_id_type_id.description: v2 only: numeric game id type. 1 is Steam.

server_ip.description: v1 only: override REQUEST_IP. Empty derives from server cvars.

server_port.description: v1 only: override REQUEST_PORT. 0 derives from hostport.

ip_arg_encoding.description: v1 only: client-IP info argument encoding: plain, base64, or omit.

user_agent.default: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/140.0 Safari/537.36
user_agent.description: User-Agent sent with MAUL API calls.

autotag.description: Rename players to the MAUL rank tag plus MAUL name.

presence.description: v2 only: report live roster to MAUL presence.

presence_interval_ms.description: v2 presence snapshot cadence, floored to 5000 ms.
